title: LDZ Flow 1.0.0
body:
LDZ Flow 1.0.0

- New Obsidian Wave visual identity and LDZ Flow branding.
- Refined startup splash experience.
- Improved Android Auto navigation and media UX.
- Fixed the release startup crash caused by Sentry instrumentation without its runtime.
- Reduced scrolling overhead by caching Obsidian Wave graphics and removing duplicate full-screen rendering.
- General stability and performance improvements.
